about: 7 Wonders Duel Pantheon: the 5 Mythologies, their 15 Divinities and the Gate (docs/research/expansions.md Part A, section 3; docs/spec-pantheon.md). Effects other than the numbers below are implemented in the Engine by id. Card game facts (c) Repos Production.

format.mythologies: in spec order; tokens = Mythology tokens of that kind in the box (5 of the 10 are used each game)
format.mythology: the Mythology deck the Divinity belongs to; the Gate has none
format.vp: victory points at the end of the game
format.coins: coins taken from the bank on activation
format.protectedCoins: coins put on the card on activation: spendable, safe from coin loss, 1 VP each at the end
format.science: the scientific symbol the Divinity counts as
